package.name: Finco1 Next Validation Roadmap after Generic Loop

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate Generic Solar output against a real reference solar model.
roadmap_rows.blocker: No reference solar model is available.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: reference solar model; reference solar output (IRR, EBITDA, DSCR, etc.); comparison report (Generic Solar vs reference solar)
roadmap_rows.owner: User (reference-model validation) + Agent A (implementation) + Agent B (governance)
roadmap_rows.dependency: reference solar model must be available
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Generic Solar output is Excel-parity validated against the reference solar model
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: Reference solar model unavailable; comparison report indicates non-trivial delta

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate Generic Wind output against a real reference wind model.
roadmap_rows.blocker: No reference wind model is available.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: reference wind model; reference wind output (IRR, EBITDA, DSCR, etc.); comparison report (Generic Wind vs reference wind)
roadmap_rows.owner: User (reference-model validation) + Agent A (implementation) + Agent B (governance)
roadmap_rows.dependency: reference wind model must be available
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Generic Wind output is Excel-parity validated against the reference wind model
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: Reference wind model unavailable; comparison report indicates non-trivial delta

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate the CAPEX 2.0 editable workspace (the editable CAPEX sub-lines) against the existing CAPEX model.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: Per-PR validation evidence (Phase 57A-9B, 57A-9C, 57A-9D, 57A-9E, 57A-10, and later phases)
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: CAPEX sub-lines are saved, loaded, run, and exported correctly
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: CAPEX sub-line delta detected for TUHO or Oborovo

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate the scenario compare (2-way, 3-way, 4-way) internal functionality.
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: User visual review of the compare panel; controlled pilot run per B45
roadmap_rows.owner: Agent A (implementation) + Agent B (governance) + User (visual review)
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Compare panel renders correctly; 3-way / 4-way compare renders correctly; multi-compare picker integrates with the compare panel
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: Compare panel broken; multi-compare picker broken

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate the export / download pack (Generic scenarios).
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: Per-PR validation evidence (Phase 24-H-4); export artifact evidence (collected during the controlled pilot, per B45 task T9)
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: User visual review of the export / download artifacts; controlled pilot run per B45
roadmap_rows.owner: Agent A (implementation) + Agent B (governance) + User (visual review)
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Export artifacts are generated correctly; the exploratory banner is visible for Generic Solar / Wind exports
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: Export artifacts broken; exploratory banner missing for Generic Solar / Wind exports

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate the What Changed Delta Indicator (Phase 25B-3 / PR #586).
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: Per-PR validation evidence (Phase 25B-3 / PR #586, 84 new tests reported green in the PR body)
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: User visual review of the What Changed panel; controlled pilot run per B45
roadmap_rows.owner: Agent A (implementation) + Agent B (governance) + User (visual review)
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: What Changed panel renders correctly; the exploratory banner is visible for Generic Solar / Wind; the panel is gated on card.is_user_project; factory projects do not render the panel
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: What Changed panel broken; exploratory banner missing for Generic Solar / Wind; panel rendering for factory projects

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate the persistence metadata rotation (Phase 25B-3 / PR #586).
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: Per-PR validation evidence (Phase 25B-3 / PR #586); persistence and records guardrails CI green
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: Long-term persistence reliability evidence (multi-month save-load cycles)
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Persistence rotation is correct for runs 1, 2, 3, 4+; corrupted / missing replay_metadata is tolerated; other replay_metadata keys are preserved across writes; factory project run summary output is byte-identical to pre-Phase-25B-3 path
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: Factory project run summary output is NOT byte-identical; persistence rotation drift detected

roadmap_rows.objective: Validate the UI / UX (post-Phase 54-56 + post-Phase 25B-3) via user visual review and controlled pilot runs.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: User visual review of the UI; controlled pilot runs per B18, B39, B45
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: Controlled pilot runs per B45 task list (T1-T12)
roadmap_rows.owner: Agent A (implementation) + Agent B (governance) + User (visual review)
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: UI is clear and understandable; UX is consistent; no-regression
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: High-severity UX issue that blocks one or more tasks

roadmap_rows.objective: Prepare the external reviewer evidence index and onboard an external reviewer.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: B50 external reviewer evidence index; B23 reviewer question bank; external reviewer feedback
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: Identify and onboard an external reviewer; collect external reviewer feedback
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: External reviewer feedback is collected; external reviewer sign-off is received
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: External reviewer unavailable; external reviewer feedback not collected

roadmap_rows.objective: Collect controlled pilot evidence (per B45, B18, B39).
roadmap_rows.blocker: No controlled pilot has been performed.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: B18 / B39 / B45 controlled pilot runbooks; B52 controlled pilot data room index; controlled pilot run results
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: First controlled pilot run per B45
roadmap_rows.dependency: Controlled pilot must be authorized by the user
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Controlled pilot run is complete; controlled pilot evidence is collected
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: High-severity UX issue; critical data integrity issue; financial output drift on TUHO or Oborovo

roadmap_rows.objective: Review the paid pilot gate per the B25 / B33 / B35 stop / go checklists.
roadmap_rows.blocker: Paid pilot gate review is gated on the completion of RM-01 / RM-02 / RM-09 / RM-10.
roadmap_rows.required_evidence: Reference-model validation (RM-01, RM-02); external reviewer feedback (RM-09); controlled pilot evidence (RM-10); B25 / B33 / B35 stop / go checklists
roadmap_rows.recommended_next_PR_or_phase: Per the B25 / B33 / B35 stop / go checklists
roadmap_rows.owner: User (paid pilot gate review) + Agent B (governance)
roadmap_rows.dependency: RM-01, RM-02, RM-09, RM-10 must be complete
roadmap_rows.success_criteria: Paid pilot gate review passes; paid pilot is authorized by the user
roadmap_rows.hard_stop_condition: Any hard-stop condition in the B25 / B33 / B35 stop / go checklists; reference-model validation fails; external reviewer feedback negative; controlled pilot evidence missing

global_notes: Validation roadmap is not approval. Paid pilot requires separate gate review. External review requires external reviewer feedback. Generic output parity must be proven against reference models before any parity claim.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
